checks_run.procedure: Direct review of the round-2-to-round-3 diff 9bb2207..95f9819: 142 files in apps, packages, e2e, tests, docs/api, ADRs and operations. I read all of it, and the P6 code it touches. That covers: packages/config/src/secret-bindings.ts (parser, match rule, active manifest); platform/secrets.ts resolve(ref, use); secret-namespace.ts assertSecretRefsBound; secret-refusals.ts; organization-code.ts (API and worker); the five consumers (connectors checkConfig/connectorSecretUse/test/run/outbound, webhooks create/rotate/verify, notification-channels PUT/test and the worker delivery, storage PUT/test and s3.ts, assistant settings PUT/enable and provider); the http_pull, assistant and S3 redirect settings; access/sensitive-reach.ts (the via source); kpi/calculations.ts; benefits/scenarios.ts (BE-Z3); config load; with-stack.sh; openapi.yaml; i18n. I also judged the four points D-210 names.
checks_run.command: git diff 9bb2207667d8ef68e32e351a3782c4e9dfcdecd1..95f981917e4e5572f954d7cd159d869eca142bff; reading; probes CS-09/CS-10
checks_run.expected: No new Critical/High/Medium defect; every D-210 point judged.
checks_run.actual: No new defect found. (1) Binding: the write-time check runs after authorization, on the authorized organization (create: requireCreate before checkConfig; update: the stored row's), before any write. No remote I/O inside a transaction (the webhook rotate checks inside its transaction but only reads organization.code). Resolve time re-checks with the stored organization and the very URL the adapter calls. http_pull and the assistant use redirect 'error', and the S3 probe uses 'manual'. The SDK signs with SigV4 and never sends the key. An unbound or host-mismatched reference resolves as unset without asking the provider; `resolvable` goes through it. The not_bound answer is uniform (R2). No path resolves without a use, because the type has no such overload. Observation R6, not a defect: any ADM_TECH holds organization.manage installation-wide (DG1 design, 0005 seed). So an organization code that IT bound before the organization exists (rule A9 allows it) can be created by another organization's ADM_TECH, who then administers it. The secret still goes only to its bound host, and ADM roles read no business records (CS-12). This is a consequence of who may create organizations, not of the binding; IT can bind after creation. (2) BE-Z3: presentScenarios omits values of benefits the caller is not admitted to, on every route that returns a scenario (list, item, create, patch). A new value naming such a benefit answers the same 422 validation.reference as an unknown benefit. A value item of a sensitive benefit is 404 through the route guard (benefitScenarioValueId -> benefit_scenario_value, a benefit child). Scenarios carry no total. Acceptable. (3) Credential-less endpoints (an http_pull without credential, an SMTP relay without AUTH, an assistant endpoint) can still reach internal hosts. I judge this an acceptable residual. Only an ADM_TECH (technical configuration role) can set one. http_pull is https-only, refuses redirects, caps the body and parses a strict envelope, so content is reflected only as rows of that shape (blind reachability through error codes remains). D-209 and ADR-0052 §G leave it explicitly to the deployment's egress policy, which restricted-network.md tells IT to configure (allow only PostgreSQL, the IdP and the destinations IT configures). No secret can be carried there (CS-10). (4) ADR-0011 rule 4 lists the IdP, SMTP, connectors and the AI endpoint, not the object store. This is documentation drift with no behavioural effect, and I do not count it as a defect. The S3 adapter was planned in ADR-0010 §3 and decided in ADR-0054, which builds on ADR-0011. The operator-facing list (restricted-network.md, the S3-compatible object store row) is complete and correct. A dated ADR-0011 amendment naming it would be tidy, but nothing behaves differently. Earlier P6 judgements (ADR-0043 batching and enablement ledger 0122/0123, D-204/D-205, the documented commit-order residual, export assembly 0124/0125) stand: no worker automation, migration or export code changed since round 2, and their suites pass in both locales.
